title: The brief view (/brief, /en/brief) is the cv-ats CV on screen: same sections, the landing's dock, a still CV dialog, the animated field, canonical to its landing
body:
Decided by the author 2026-10-29. The old landing lives on as the 'vista breve' / 'brief view' at /brief and /en/brief (src/pages/brief.astro, src/pages/en/brief.astro, src/components/HomeDocument.astro; LOCALE_PATHS.*.brief). Paths are English in BOTH locales. Its canonical points at the locale's landing (Base.astro canonicalPath), astro.config.mjs's sitemap filter drops /brief/, no Open Graph, not in HREFLANG: do not change that without the author.
Look and content, per the author: as close as possible to the cv-ats PDF (Perfil, Habilidades, Experiencia, Educación, Idiomas, same cut) plus the projects, easy to read, key data set apart (figures via src/lib/highlight.ts splitFigures, metrics, companies, core skills). It keeps the animated background (src/scripts/brief/field.ts) and simple reveal-on-enter fades (src/scripts/brief/boot.ts), never scroll-tied, nothing flashy. Same header as the guided landing: the dock (src/styles/chrome.css). Download CV and 'Ver el recorrido guiado' buttons at the start and at the end. The CV dialog is the landing's C with its ESP/EN halves but STILL (no turning), as a native popover. The 3D knowledge map is gone for good.
not_derivable: The reading-first brief, the still C and the button placement were the author's instructions; the code shows the result, not which parts are requirements.
